messages:
jess: Hi @people-ops — quick heads up. Lately I've been getting frequent loud conversations near my desk and it's causing headaches / focus issues. My manager mentioned my sprint throughput dipped by a couple of points. I'm proposing a short-term accommodation: 3 weeks of flexible core hours (11am-7pm) + noise-cancelling headphones provided + move to the south quiet pod for that period. Can this be handled discreetly?

omar: @jess thanks for sharing. I'm sorry you've been dealing with that. We're ok with trying the 11-7 core window for a trial. I can also move weekly syncs later to respect your new hours. Will loop People Ops to formalize.

nina: @omar @jess looping ppl ops. Two quick things: 1) we can source headphones or reimburse; 2) seat moves are possible but depend on space. People Ops can open an intake and create a private thread. Docs are optional.

people-ops-bot: Accommodation intake form: https://intranet.redwood/pplops/accom-intake. Submit when ready.

jess: Thanks. I don't want details in my 1:1 notes. Prefer limited disclosure: manager + People Ops only.

ellaine: Hi @jess 1 I'm Elaine from People Ops. Happy to handle this. We categorize this as a short-term reasonable adjustment unless you want a formal ADA accommodation. I'll open a case and create a private channel for coordination. Trial proposal: 3 weeks starting Mon, with a check-in at the 2-week mark. We'll confirm headphone model and seat availability.

jess: Sounds good. Please note I can still do async reviews and I'll keep Friday mornings free for handoffs.

omar: We'll shift pairing sessions and move your sprint story assignments that require synchronous collab to Nina.

ellaine: Case #2028-019 opened and private channel #pops-2028-019 created. Assigned lead: nina. (automated)

jess: Appreciate it. Also would like an explicit note that this is supportive and not a disciplinary action.

ellaine: We'll mark the record as an accommodation trial and add a private manager guidance note. Only People Ops + manager + you will have access.

(End of thread)
